rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: President Dmitry Medvedev sent the Chairman of the State Duma, Boris Gryzlov, a letter in which, under Article 111(2) of the Constitution, he submitted to the State Duma the candidacy of Vladimir Putin for appointment as Chairman of the Government of the Russian Federation.
rows.locator: Headline, date line (7 May 2008, 14:50) and body
